candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
Change the token call from transferFrom to a plain transfer of value v from the contract itself, altering which balances are moved.
Remove the require(_s) check so failed token transfers no longer revert and the function can return true despite failures.
Transfer v+1 instead of v to each recipient, changing the amounts moved by the token calls.
Loop only over _tos.length-1 recipients, skipping the last address in the list.
